title: BPW-2026-0606
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0606
BOE + BOS
CD 14
CONSTRUCTION BUDGET AND AWARD – MIKE BUBALO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC.
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE a construction budget of $3,057,087, including contingency, for the Emergency Sewer Repair Fickett Street (800 Block) Project;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to award this Project to the lowest, responsive and responsible bidder, Mike Bubalo Construction Company, Inc. in compliance with established procedures of the On-Call Emergency Sewer and Storm Drain Repairs Contract; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue construction orders and revised construction orders up to the authorized construction budget for this Project to Mike Bubalo Construction Company, Inc.
(W.O.: SZC14612, C-141939)
summary: Sets a $3.06 million construction budget for an emergency sewer repair on Fickett Street and authorizes the City Engineer to award it to Mike Bubalo Construction Company, Inc. and issue construction orders up to that budget.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
